topic: Adjacent and terminal differences in OEIS A378495, with attribution of the row-gcd theorem to Su and the later independent proof of Kallat
title: OEIS A378495, FORMULA (revision #70): refutation and correction

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We refute the adjacent-column Conjecture and prove the terminal-column Conjecture in the FORMULA section of Peter Kagey's OEIS entry A378495, revision #70 of October 17, 2026. For n>=5 the corrected adjacent difference is n!/[2(n-2)]=abs(A238474(n-3)); at n=4 it is 3. The literal conjecture fails at n=5, where its sides are 20 and 6. The earliest proof found of the row gcd, both differences and the index correction is Lien-Hung Su, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445724 v1 (October 18, 2026), Theorem 7.3, Proposition 7.4 and Remark 7.5; Ahaan Kallat gives a later independent proof in arXiv:2610.40342v1 (October 29, 2026), Theorem 4.1. This note gives a self-contained treatment of the differences and their boundary.
summary: Self-contained difference proofs and finite exact checks, with Su credited for the earliest proof found of all three conjectures and the index correction, followed by Kallat's later independent proof.
